protocol: local capture only; no send, recipient, inbox, or product networking
criteria: provisional experiment bounds; not product budgets

registry.note: The shared registry change is append-only and selects the fixed lab10 adapter allowlist key.

runner.scripted_drawing_marker: LAB10_SCRIPTED_DRAWING status=started ... cadence_profile=scripted-cadence-36-36-36-40-40-v2; completion includes terminal=duration_cap duration_cap_ms=180000 accepted_points=<3400..4095> strokes=<6..18> palette_changes=<5..17> accepted_color_mask=0x3e hardware_touch=0
runner.scripted_timing_diagnostic: One app_main LAB10_SCRIPTED_DIAGNOSTIC line reports ui_poll_count, max_ui_poll_gap_us, scripted_event_count, max_event_deadline_lateness_us, and late_event_count from the scripted scheduler; parser output preserves the optional diagnostic record and validates the complete timing field group when present.
runner.scripted_completion_rule: Only the UI-task scheduler may emit status=complete after the capture itself terminalizes with duration_cap at or after 180000 ms and reports 3400..4095 accepted points, at least six strokes and five palette changes, all five ink colors represented in accepted points, and no trace loss. The 4096th point is the point-cap terminal and cannot qualify as duration-cap completion. Stop, cancel, early termination, point cap, queue overflow, failure, malformed fields, or missing evidence cannot close the scripted workflow as passed.
runner.manual_terminal_presentation: In manual mode, a natural duration_cap at 180000 ms presents Completed. A red-button early stop presents Stopped; cancel presents Cancelled; point_cap, queue_overflow, allocation failure, and other faults present Failed. This UI presentation does not change the capture terminal kind or imply an experiment PASS. Scripted duration_cap remains pending until scheduler qualification resolves; accepted qualification presents Completed, while rejected or unresolved qualification never presents Completed.
runner.marker_uniqueness: one readiness, one run, one cancel, and at most one terminal scenario status per scenario identity

parser_output.failure_behavior: malformed, ambiguous, over-bound, or incomplete trace evidence never becomes a hardware PASS

logical_canvas.stored_coordinates: logical only, with raw and display coordinates retained in trace evidence

touch_routing.outside_display: reject and count; never clamp into the canvas

palette.coordinate_convention: integer display pixels; circle boundary and bounding-box endpoints are inclusive
palette.hit_test: a rail touch selects the swatch whose (x-cx)^2 + (y-cy)^2 <= 22^2; touches in the rail outside all circles are rail_rejected

queue.name: capture_touch_report_fifo
queue.overflow: emit queue_overflow, preserve the overflow count, and terminalize exactly once; never silently drop or overwrite

minimum_movement.rule: coalesce only a consecutive MOVE for the same stroke, same selected color, same logical coordinate, and Euclidean display distance < 2 px from the last accepted point

implementation.session_guard: lab10_capture_session_id_t: nonzero unsigned 64-bit generation; every issued generation is permanently consumed and never reused

session_generation.reuse_policy: never reuse or wrap; a paused stale producer must fail generation admission after restart
session_generation.exhaustion_policy: start returns the invalid value and leaves the terminal session unchanged

implementation.terminal_arbitration: atomic ACTIVE -> TERMINATING -> TERMINAL lifecycle with an in-flight producer count; terminal cleanup waits only for an admitted bounded producer section
implementation.overflow_arbitration: one-shot overflow latch observed after producer quiescence; an admitted full-queue report outranks stop, cancel, complete, and duration before terminal publication
implementation.terminal_cleanup: clear raw FIFO and close active stroke exactly once; release point result on renderer release, next start, or destroy

adapter_limits.native_test_touch_ids: native capture tests inject nonzero IDs

phase_rules.DOWN: starts one active stroke when routed to the canvas and capacity remains
phase_rules.MOVE: accepted only for the active first touch; preserve phase, stroke identity, and color
phase_rules.UP: closes the active stroke; it is a boundary event, not an additional accepted point
phase_rules.palette_change: updates the color for subsequent points and never rewrites prior points
phase_rules.second_touch: reject with explicit reason and no canvas mutation
phase_rules.leave_reenter: a leave ends the active stroke; a later DOWN starts a new stroke
phase_rules.terminality: one and only one terminal outcome per capture operation

capacity_outcomes.duration_cap: terminal outcome duration_cap at or after 180000 ms on the monotonic clock; no later point is accepted
capacity_outcomes.point_cap: terminal outcome point_cap after the 4096th accepted canvas point; no silent truncation
capacity_outcomes.queue_overflow: terminal outcome queue_overflow on a full capture queue; raw report and loss are counted
capacity_outcomes.allocation_failure: terminal outcome failed with allocation_failure; all owned resources must be released

scripted_device_workload.source: LVGL timer/UI task through lab10_ui_handle_touch and the normal capture queue
scripted_device_workload.stroke_model: 18 deterministic 200-point target strokes through UI routing; three-segment corner paths with edge-adjacent points
completion_requires: capture terminal outcome is duration_cap at or after 180000 ms
at least 3400 and at most 4095 canvas points were accepted before duration terminalization
at least six strokes and five palette changes were accepted, with strokes equal to palette changes plus one
accepted points include all five ink colors represented by mask 0x3e and the trace has no loss
scripted UI DOWN and palette-selection events were emitted

logical_framebuffer.display_expansion: each logical pixel is presented as a bounded 2x2 display block

direct_point.semantics: publish one accepted point without interpolation

segment.semantics: bounded Bresenham interpolation only within one stroke and one color

bounded_batch.semantics: segment semantics with independent point and raster limits

whole_frame.semantics: build a second framebuffer and publish it in bounded logical-pixel chunks

rendering_policy.hardware_selection: package-local LAB10_RENDER_MODE Kconfig choice; default segment candidate for pen-like same-stroke drawing; direct_point remains an explicitly labeled control
rendering_policy.whole_frame_publication: never copy or invalidate the whole logical frame in one UI-task update
rendering_policy.lock_semantics: the LVGL adapter reports ui_task_owned; lock acquisition timing is not measured by host or this slice
rendering_policy.test_hooks: bounded raster, publication, invalidation, update, and lock-state callbacks are production-safe observer hooks; no capture test-hook macro is required

clock.hardware_source: monotonic device clock (microseconds; esp_timer_get_time or an equivalent monotonic source)
clock.hardware_rule: all device event, latency, duration, queue, and cleanup timestamps use the same monotonic clock; wall clock is not valid for ordering
clock.host_rule: host synthetic timestamps are separate evidence and cannot establish touch latency, display scanout, audio continuity, or hardware scheduling

manual.purpose: human touch and visual behavior; use an external camera/microphone when audio or scanout is claimed
required_cases: sparse strokes at slow, medium, and fast human speeds
continuous stroke with pauses and corners
dense multicolor drawing with multiple strokes
leave canvas and re-enter with a new stroke

deterministic_human_like.evidence_kind: host synthetic evidence only; never hardware latency evidence
deterministic_human_like.seed_policy: nonzero uint64 seed is recorded in workload_metadata.seed and reproduces the complete trace

audio_concurrency_scenarios.description: Audio-only control with no canvas events.
Few drawing events while audio producer and consumer remain balanced.
One drawing event is submitted and processed on each audio tick.
Drawing queue pressure is injected while the audio queue remains balanced.
Frequent color changes between drawing events with balanced audio.
Stop with audio and drawing queues active; all resources must be released.
Cancel with audio and drawing queues active; all resources must be released.
Inject an audio capture failure and verify terminal cleanup.
Reject the bounded PCM allocation before audio starts.

metric_schema.percentile_semantics: nearest-rank: sort finite samples ascending, use one-based rank ceil(p*n/100) clamped to [1,n]; p50/p95/p99/max are emitted only from real samples; an empty series is value=null, sample_count=0, with missing_reason
metric_schema.missing_behavior: missing or unavailable evidence is value=null, sample_count=0, provenance=unmeasured/blocked unless an explicit field-level provenance identifies the attempted source; missing is never zero-filled or a pass
metric_schema.hardware_only_unmeasured_reason: hardware-only metric; host cannot measure device task scheduling, stack high-water, heap free space, PSRAM free space, or fragmentation

required_artifacts: raw serial trace or host trace
external synchronized screen/audio recording for hardware audio or scanout claims
evidence.workflow_vs_experiment: workflow completion does not imply experiment PASS; missing hardware evidence remains UNMEASURED or BLOCKED
evidence.parser_output: family-link.lab10-parser-output/v1; metrics are the L10-07 aggregator output with parser identity, lifecycle markers, diagnostics, and evidence provenance
evidence.trace_loss: any trace loss makes affected measurements incomplete; it cannot be inferred as zero

required_for_manual: registered ESP32-S3 Box-3 kit and matching USB serial binding
clean LAB-10 firmware build with LAB10_READY readiness marker
external synchronized screen capture for visual/scanout claims
external synchronized microphone/speaker capture for audio claims
required_for_deterministic: registered kit and matching USB serial binding for a device run
synthetic workload identity, nonzero seed, and lab10-workload/v1 metadata
not_provided_by_host_runner: microphone, codec, DAC, DMA, speaker, display scanout, touch latency, task scheduling, heap/PSRAM/stack measurement

preserved_residual_disclosures: application IRAM has 1 byte free after successful link; L10-06 does not relax or remeasure that residual
hardware visual/touch/scanout/lock/resource/audio evidence remains unmeasured unless the required kit and synchronized capture are present
host_may_verify: coordinate mapping and palette hit geometry
parser, schema, workload generator, and metric aggregation
deterministic renderer pressure and format-size calculations
render mode semantics, bounded update work, backlog drain, and host callbacks
bounded audio producer/consumer accounting, scenario expectations, drawing queue pressure, failure injection, and deterministic cleanup
hardware_required_for: actual visible color fidelity and display publication timing
audio continuity, underruns, and synchronized screen/audio conclusions
host_hardware_boundary.unmeasured_rule: a host result must not be labeled as hardware evidence; absent or unsynchronized hardware artifacts are unmeasured/blocked
host_hardware_boundary.audio_model_boundary: audio continuity, occupancy, overrun, underrun, sample/frame counts, and cleanup are host-model measurements only; DAC, microphone, codec, DMA, task scheduling, and audible continuity remain unmeasured/blocked

lab03_boundary: LAB-03 is playback-only evidence. Its playback traces do not prove LAB-10 capture, touch, recording, or audio-concurrency behavior.
exclusions: recording timer or on-screen recording indicator
historical v1 archive modifications or build-time dependencies
hardware performance claims from host-only tests
touch latency, scanout, LVGL lock timing, or hardware task/memory claims from host-only renderer tests
firmware audio/DAC health claims from the bounded host model
silent point, report, queue, or terminal truncation
promotion of provisional experiment bounds into product budgets

reserved_commands.status: L10-08 runner and parser registered; hardware capture remains dependent on a registered kit and required synchronized evidence
